ledger_scope: Flagged material claims and ambiguities, after reading all six held-out summary/synthesis outputs against supplied sources. Supported content is described through coverage and review notes; not an exhaustive standardized atomic-claim denominator.
annotation_limits: Qualification loss, event contradiction, citation drift, attribution and ambiguity remain distinct. Flag counts are not independent false-fact totals or comparable precision percentages.
supported_content_review: Hunnic description is assigned to Huns, food direction is correct, and the army rescue at Thessalonica remains hypothetical. H2’s practical solution of the empire’s division is awkward but does not clearly reverse separation to continuity. Source John VI numbering is preserved. Full control’s only significant Latin populations agrees with the source’s considerable-population qualifier and is not the direct-summary holdouts overstatement.
citation_review: H3-Q3’s citation contradicts the first-stage answer. H4-Q1’s cited passage supports the ruler and by-bound but not the asserted exact year; H2-Q4’s full answer spans 174–175. Full control admission conditions are on 63 rather than 62. Renewed vassalage in the direct/merged H4 is on 365 rather than 362. Parenthesized physical-page references in full control are citations despite zero literal PDF markers.
synthesis_review: Merged output mostly copies parent summaries with minor rewrites, propagating four clear families and introducing the Guns typo. Some initial author-attribution wording disappears in H4, separately noted. Independent full control covers H1/H2 and omits H3/H4; it introduces an explicit siege and a broader apathy-cause claim.
